items.title: WordPress: Unauthenticated path traversal leading to conditional RCE
items.reason: Critical (CVSS 9.2) unauthenticated RCE in a piece of software a huge fraction of the web runs on, already patched — actionable for anyone running WordPress.
key_facts: Path traversal in get_page_template() lets unauthenticated attackers include arbitrary readable PHP files (e.g. pearcmd.php) for RCE

Requires an active theme whose top-level dir starts with 'page-' (Twenty Twelve/Fourteen, Neve, Hestia, Sydney) plus a readable pearcmd.php with register_argc_argv on (default in official PHP Docker images)
Affects WordPress 4.7.0–7.1.1; patched in 7.1.2 and backported to older branches

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5

Available immediately on Claude.ai, AWS, GCP, Azure

items.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
items.reason: Genuine AI-for-science result from Anthropic (not a product launch) — Claude autonomously found a real, previously-unrecognized enzyme system; substantive enough that not knowing it is a gap.
key_facts: Claude found 'array-associated reverse transcriptases' (ART) in bacteriophages: an RT enzyme + partner gene + CRISPR-array-like repeats
~950 Claude agents ran 21 hours, 210M tokens, screened 200k+ reverse transcriptases down to 3,500 candidates then 20 compelling ones
The RT itself was known, but Claude was first to notice the associated non-coding array + accessory protein — the defining CRISPR-like feature
MIT's Feng Zhang commented positively; function still unknown, released as a preprint, further wet-lab work ongoing
